text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! The tropical south is steaming hot!
Time to
hit the waves and―

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Chiyo, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Sorry, I just, um, you know... I-I
didn't realize
how fancy the place would
be!
So here we are at an upscale inn, complete with a private beach. As for how we got here... It all started just yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't believe how good the food
is at my
relatives' inn down south!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I wish I could try some... I'd love to
know
what your favorite dishes are!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Really? How about we swing by then?

And just like that, I end up chaperoning
a luxury
getaway trip.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The gate leading in is huge, and the
rooms are so
spacious and secluded...
There's even an open-air
bath, a-and
everything is so serene and just—I
can't
believe my eyes!
Rumble...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eek! S-sorry about that! I completely
forgot about
eating breakfast...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's no problem at all. Can't run
with no
gas in the tank. Let's go for some
lunch!

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
This is a local specialty, steamed in our
island's
traditional style. Please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. All righty, let's
dig in
before the food gets cold! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-time to dig in! Wow, I've never seen
Japanese
cuisine like this before! Um...
Where do I even
start?

As Sakura Chiyono O hesitates on what
to eat,
Maruzensky casually removes a
lid from one of
the bowls.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. I should probably start with
the soup...
Huh? The lid won't come off.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that? If you hold the bowl down
with your left
hand and give the lid a
twist, it should pop right
off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: R-right! Thank you!
As we continue to eat our lunch...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so rich and fatty! This fish really is
the
bomb!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... Maruzen? Wh-what do I... do with
the fish
bones?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to use the kaishi paper.
It's like
a napkin—you put the bones
inside to keep them
out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I see! So that's what this paper is for...

Maruzensky maintains impeccable
manners as she
finishes her meal, leaving
her plates spotless.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my aunt should be arriving soon. I'll
dip out
for a second to say hi!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay! See you in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen's plates sure are clean.
Meanwhile, mine
are a complete mess...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know, but... it's definitely a reminder
that
Maruzen and I live in completely
different worlds.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everything's so fancy, but she's
completely at
home. She's so polite, and
elegant, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eep, what am I saying? Please don't tell
her any
of that!

With how much Chiyono O looks up to

Maruzensky, it's making her feel out of
place
around her. I wonder if there's
anything I can do...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo seems down. Did something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you know anything?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you know anything?
choice_data_list: 実は、悩んでいるみたいで……
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure it's just your imagination!
Actually, it seems she's troubled about something...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Hm, maybe I'm just
overthinking it.
choice_data_list: 実は、悩んでいるみたいで……
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure it's just your imagination!
Actually, it seems she's troubled about something...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Um, sorry for keeping you two waiting.
I'm done
changing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Chiyo! That reminds me,
there's
something I wanted to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For tonight's dessert, they're making
vanilla ice
cream blended with mixed
berries.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And trust me—it gives the academy's
steamed
carrot buns a run for their
money! It's the real
bee's knees!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're saying this dessert... is on par
with the
school's?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It is! Like, I'd be happy with just dinner,
but
knowing there'll be an extra special
treat with it
has me all revved up!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why we need to get running and
work up a
big appetite!

Sakura Chiyono O blinks in disbelief
before
breaking into laughter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, did I say something funny?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing... I agree. We've gotta
make room
for dessert! Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Let's get to work! Some sweet
waves are
starting to roll in!

It seems Maruzensky's frank, casual
language has
worked away Sakura
Chiyono O's worries.

The two run off towards the blue sea, all
smiles.

I explain to Maruzensky how Sakura
Chiyono O
had been comparing the two
of them and ended
up a bit
self-conscious about their differences.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You don't say... So that's how she's been
feeling,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know just the thing... Let me switch up
our
schedule real quick!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, is this supposed to be a...
ninety-minute
all-you-can-eat dessert
bar?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Sorry for being so last
minute. I heard
they had limited-time
cherry blossom-themed
sweets, so I
really wanted to check it out with
you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Lookie here! There's petals floating
inside the
jelly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're right! How cute!

The cute but sophisticated sweets on
display
seem to be making Sakura
Chiyono O's heart
flutter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Cherry blossom mont blancs,
cherry
blossom custard pudding, cherry
blossom lattes...
It's all so lovely!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Oh Chiyo, you should see the
smile on your
face right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I can't help it when everything's
so
delicious! It's like... "Dessert is an
Umamusume's
best friend!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I really want to try this one with you
guys! I'll go
grab some!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Looks like she's back to her
good old
self. What a relief.

Maruzensky gently smiles as she watches
Sakura
skip over to the cakes.
